name: forestwatch-ai
description: Public-interest web platform for exploring forest cover and monitoring suspected forest loss from Sentinel-2 imagery

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@forestwatch/shared && npm run build --workspace=@forestwatch/api
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=@forestwatch/shared && npm run build --workspace=@forestwatch/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@forestwatch/shared && npm run build --workspace=@forestwatch/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@forestwatch/api & npm run dev --workspace=@forestwatch/web
